dedupe_keys.name: catalogue of urban nature based solutions sendzimir foundation climate nbs poland

description: The Catalogue of urban nature-based solutions of the Sendzimir Foundation, a Polish sustainability think tank, is designed to help planners, designers and landscape architects in urban areas of all sizes in Europe and beyond apply nature-based solutions instead of, or alongside, traditional approaches. It presents a wide selection of solutions with case studies deployed in Germany chosen for their high climate mitigation potential and wide applicability, with information on cost-effectiveness and climate mitigation potential and implementation guidelines, and shows how solutions can be combined into systemic responses at scales from a playground to a whole city. It was produced in the Climate NBS Poland project, supported by the European Climate Initiative (EUKI) of the German environment ministry, and is to be complemented by a guide on policy instruments for nature-based solutions. The catalogue is a free download in PDF, MOBI and EPUB; no licence is stated on the page read. Caveats: it is a publication of case studies, not a structured dataset, and the cases are from Germany. Coverage is Europe, with German case studies. It supports the choice of nature-based measures for stormwater, heat and flood adaptation around roads, buildings and drainage networks; related records are the Oppla nature-based solutions repository and the OICS sustainable cities solutions cases.
